Message:
[SCSI] qla4xxx: Fix failure of mbox 0x31

Issue:
While unloading driver MBOX 0x31 fail as DDB logout (MBOX 0x56)
operation is not completed.

Fix:
Wait for DDB Logout completion before MBOX 0x31
